summary: Iteration 5 FRONTEND E2E (Phase F: append-only stock ledger posting + booking reconcile + reversal + Stock Ledger page). All 5 requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end with the live UI against Django+Postgres backend. Verified: (1) PT POST without booking on file 47 (DSY.xlsx, sent) -> stage badge transitions to 'Posted to system', ptfile-posted-banner shows voucher '26-27/RAN-WH/PT/6' with ptfile-ledger-link href '/ledgers/stock?doc=26-27%2FRAN-WH%2FPT%2F6', post+recall+booking-select disappear and ptfile-reverse appears. (2) Stock Ledger page at /ledgers/stock loads under nav 'Ledgers -> Stock Ledger' for owner/warehouse/accounts; stock-summary renders 4 cards with non-zero numbers (276 entries / 162 net qty / Rs 239891.88 / 175 SKUs); stock-entries-table lists rows with voucher, green 'PT inward' chip, store=RAN-WH, barcode, qty, value. Filtering ?doc=26-27/RAN-WH/PT/6 from the ledger-link shows stock-doc-filter banner and exactly 23 entries (all kind=PT inward, voucher=26-27/RAN-WH/PT/6). (3) Post WITH booking on file 45 (DEAL SS26 2970.xlsx, sent) using ptfile-booking-select=BK-SS26-0001 (Peter England) -> banner shows 'voucher 26-27/RAN-WH/PT/7 . reconciled to booking BK-SS26-0001'. (4) Reverse posting on file 47 -> stage returns to 'Sent to Patna' (NOT mapping, per spec), post/recall/booking-select reappear, reverse hidden; the reversal wrote 23 'PT reversal' (red chip) negative-qty mirror rows under a new gap-free voucher 26-27/RAN-WH/PT/8 (e.g. PE-FSHIRT-001 size 39 qty -5, PE-TROUSER-100 size 32 qty -3, etc.) so net qty across the two vouchers for those barcodes is 0. (5) Role gating: as wh.patna on POSTED file 45 -> post/reverse/booking-select/recall/edit all hidden, only Excel+CSV exports visible (read-only + exports); as wh.patna on SENT file 47 -> post/booking-select/recall hidden (Patna/owner only); wh.patna can read Stock Ledger. Voucher numbering is monotonic & gap-free (PT/1..PT/8 observed, count matches inward+reversal events). Ledger reads back instantly via /api/stockledger/{entries,summary}; no console errors observed.

issues: When filtering by the original posting voucher (e.g. ?doc=26-27/RAN-WH/PT/6), the reversal mirror rows are NOT included because they sit under a new voucher (PT/8). The ptfile-ledger-link still points to the original voucher only, so a user clicking it after a reverse will see net qty=29 for that filter and not see the mirror -29 (which lives at PT/8). Net qty across both nets to 0 only in the unfiltered view. Consider either (a) linking the reversal to the same doc_number, or (b) showing both vouchers in the filter (e.g. doc=PT/6 includes 'reverses of PT/6'), or (c) showing a 'related vouchers' link in the filter banner.

Value column for rows posted from files with blank BASIC (e.g. DSY.xlsx -> voucher PT/6) is 0.00 across all entries. This is technically correct per the deterministic mapper (BASIC blank => value=0), but the ledger has no visual cue (e.g. amber tint or 'no BASIC' hint) - a user might mistake it for a posting bug. Cosmetic suggestion only.

action_items: (optional/cosmetic) Make the ptfile-ledger-link surface BOTH the original posting voucher AND any reversal voucher(s) after a reverse, so a user can verify net qty nets to 0 from a single click. Backend models could expose a 'related_doc_numbers' list per source_file, or the UI could compute it client-side via /api/stockledger/entries?source_file=<id>.

(optional/cosmetic) When source row BASIC is blank, the resulting StockLedgerEntry.value_paise=0; consider surfacing this with a visual chip ('no value') in the Stock Ledger table so it's clearly not a calc bug.
critical_code_review_comments: StockLedger.tsx is clean & focused (141 lines); uses Promise.all to fetch entries+summary in parallel; respects ?doc filter; correct red/green chip via kind=='pt_inward'.
PtMapper.tsx is now 540+ lines hosting 4 routes; recommend splitting per route (PtFileDetailPage.tsx, StageStepper.tsx, ReviewQueuePage.tsx) before next phase (carried over from iteration_4).

Stock Ledger entries table is unvirtualized; with 354 rows DOM is fine, but at >2-3k entries this will get heavy. Add server-side pagination on /api/stockledger/entries (or react-window) before production.
Booking dropdown is populated from GET /api/bookings with no search/filter; with 2 seeded bookings this is fine, but with 100+ bookings the native select will be unwieldy. Consider a typeahead later.

ptfile-posted-banner correctly composes voucher + optional 'reconciled to booking <num>' + posted_at + lock notice + ledger link; all required data-testids are present (ptfile-booking-select, ptfile-post, ptfile-reverse, ptfile-posted-banner, ptfile-ledger-link, stock-summary, stock-entries-table, stock-doc-filter, stock-entry-<id>, stock-empty).
Role gating on the client is correctly defense-in-depth with the backend (warehouse on posted/sent files cannot see post/reverse/recall/booking-select), matching iteration_4 findings.

Voucher numbering is gap-free and monotonic per FY+store+kind (PT/1..PT/8 observed, including reversal vouchers in the same sequence) - confirms backend's financial_year + voucher-counter logic is solid.
